## What's Changed
* fix: prune expired model cooldowns from session state by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/2
* feat: detect retryable errors through error.cause chain by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/3
* feat: narrow try-again pattern, add configurable retry_on_patterns by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/4
* feat: recover to original model after cooldown expires by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/5
* feat: make max_attempts a sliding window, not a lifetime cap by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/6
* feat: optional exponential backoff with jitter before re-prompting by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/7
* feat: optional debug logging of fallback decisions by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/8
* feat: per-model failure counts and switch history in status by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/9
* docs: add CHANGELOG.md by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/10
* docs: troubleshooting, option comparison, new options in README by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/11
* test: in-process e2e via SDK server; fix recovery race with echoed chat.message by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/12
* fix: address Copilot review feedback from PRs #2 and #3 by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/13
* chore: release v1.1.0 by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/14
* Release v1.1.0 by @ShutovKS in https://github.com/ShutovKS/opencode-model-fallback/pull/15
